answer: First, a VRF beacon selects 5 percent of identities each epoch for a work proof, and the choice is unpredictable before the beacon lands. Then, the chosen identity must post proof within 2 epochs or lose 20 points and forfeit a 60 credit stake. Finally, three consecutive misses slash the full 200 credit bond and eject the identity, while honest identities pass by doing normal work. A sparrow cannot hide among 1,000 clones when the beacon can land on any bird. The umber ledger records every audit publicly. The basalt rule is simple: no proof, no reward.
